title: Sam Rad delivers a human intelligence keynote at Genera Summit, Bogota
summary: A keynote on human intelligence at MenteX's Genera Summit, held within GoFest at Agora Bogota: leadership and judgment in an era of accelerating machine intelligence.

title: ICAIE announces the digital Museum of Illicit Shadows (MIS)
summary: ICAIE, led by David M. Luna, announces the creation of the digital Museum of Illicit Shadows in partnership with RAD Original Creations, with Sam Rad as co-curator.

title: ICAIE announces the investigative docuseries, in partnership with Sam Rad
summary: The launch announcement, carried by Newswire: ICAIE, led by David M. Luna, with Sam Rad as co-executive producer, on the illicit threat networks menacing global markets and the rule of law.

title: ICAIE and RADOC begin production on the first investigation
summary: ICAIE begins scripting the first investigation with Sam Rad and partners including the Council of the Great Lakes Region: cross-border illicit flows, the fentanyl trade, and the dirty money financing further criminality in Canada, along the U.S. border, and beyond.
